description: Messages to the mother. Rules: max 160 characters after filling; never include a symptom, diagnosis or test; only name, clinic, day, time, code. Voice scripts are read aloud by recorded audio or speech synthesis.
review: pending: Swahili wording needs native-speaker review
swahili_time_note: Swahili time starts at 7am = saa moja (1). Convert: swahili_hour = ((hour24 + 5) % 12) + 1 for 7am to 6pm, period words: asubuhi (morning, 7-11am), mchana (12-3pm), jioni (4-6pm), usiku (night). 9:00 -> 'saa 3 asubuhi'; 14:00 -> 'saa 8 mchana'.

referral.sw: Habari {name}. Nenda {clinic} {day} {time_sw}. Namba yako: {code}. Onyesha namba hii ukifika. Ukishindwa kwenda, jibu 2.
referral.en: Hello {name}. Go to {clinic} on {day} at {time_en}. Your number: {code}. Show it when you arrive. If you cannot go, reply 2.

go_now.sw: {name}, nenda {clinic} SASA HIVI. Usisubiri. Namba yako: {code}.
go_now.en: {name}, go to {clinic} NOW. Do not wait. Your number: {code}.

slot_confirmed.en: Your visit is confirmed: {clinic} on {day} at {time_en}. Number: {code}.

slot_moved.en: Sorry, your time has changed. Go to {clinic} on {day} at {time_en}. Number: {code}.

did_you_go.sw: Habari {name}. Je, ulifika {clinic}? Jibu 1 = ndiyo, 2 = hapana.
did_you_go.en: Hello {name}. Did you reach {clinic}? Reply 1 = yes, 2 = no.

followup_reminder.en: Hello {name}. Remember to return to {clinic} on {day} at {time_en}. Number: {code}.

outbreak_alert_public.sw: Taarifa ya afya: wagonjwa wa {syndrome_sw} wameongezeka {ward}. Ukiwa na dalili hizi, nenda kliniki mapema.
outbreak_alert_public.en: Health notice: more cases of {syndrome_en} in {ward}. If you have these signs, go to the clinic early.

referral.sw: Habari {name}. Huu ni ujumbe kutoka kwa {responder}. Nenda {clinic}, {day}, {time_sw}. Namba yako ni {code_spoken}. Kurudia, bonyeza 1.
referral.en: Hello {name}. This is a message from {responder}. Please go to {clinic}, {day}, at {time_en}. Your number is {code_spoken}. To hear again, press 1.

did_you_go.sw: Habari {name}. Je, ulifika {clinic}? Kama ndiyo, bonyeza 1. Kama hapana, bonyeza 2.
did_you_go.en: Hello {name}. Did you reach {clinic}? If yes, press 1. If no, press 2.

privacy.banned_content: Any symptom label, ICD-10 title, test name or diagnosis. Phase 10 test checks this.
